text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on February 4, 2026. Councillor Morley, during the afternoon session of the meeting, wished Members of Council a happy Black History Month and, as Chair of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee, gave remarks underscoring the important role the City of Toronto is playing as a leader in the space of confronting anti-Black racism. Councillor Cheng, during the afternoon session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that on the weekend she had walked with over 100,000 Iranians in solidarity with a community gripped with fear and uncertainty over the situation in Iran. Councillor Cheng acknowledged the painful situation and extended her support to the Toronto Iranian Staff Network.
